purpose: Retrospective threshold exploration against one rejected and 23 accepted clips; NOT held-out validation

proposed_rule.smoothing: 3 sample median; 5 fps; missing frames are unknown

caveats: Only one positive example; thresholds selected after seeing user decisions.
No absolute quality test for uniformly blurred clips.
Motion and occlusion can still lower scores.
Intervals have about 0.2 s sampling resolution; a short clip may not meet the 2 s threshold.
Unknown measurement support never establishes good quality.
